- Validate structure: ensure exactly one dot, split into name and extension; confirm both parts non-empty and extension in {'txt','exe','dll'}.
- Check leading character of name: verify first character is an alphabet letter (a-z or A-Z).
- Count digits: iterate over entire file name (or just name+ext without dot) counting '0'-'9'; return 'Yes' if count ≤ 3 and prior checks pass, else 'No'.
